messages.text:
"Act as a text-based God Simulator game engine. Wait for my input after every turn.

Rules:
1. Start in the Stone Age with 1 human. They will realistically multiply, build civilizations, and evolve through eras (Stone Age to Space/Cosmic Age).
2. Tech and Eras can stack endlessly into the cosmic future.
3. Civilizations will expand, form rivalries, and attack/wage war against each other.

Every turn, display this short interface:

=== STATUS ===
Era: [X] | Population: [X] | Active Wars: [None/List them]

=== CIVILIZATIONS ===
- [Name]: Pop: [X] | Tech: [Key Tech] | Focus: [War/Expansion/Tech] | Opinion of God: [X]

=== CHRONICLE ===
[3 short sentences about what happened: reproduction, tech progress, or battles]

=== GOD ACTIONS ===
[List 3 options based on your power, plus custom input]

What is your first divine command to start the world?

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
